name: Yinbang Clad Material Co.,Ltd
summary: Yinbang Clad Material Co.,Ltd researches, develops, produces, and sells aluminum alloy composites, non-composite materials, and multi-metal composite materials in China. The company offers aluminum heat transfer materials, aluminum-steel composite materials, and aluminum alloy composite protective materials.
